Hi Aisha,

Welcome — glad to start the master profile for Stolton. We're getting ready to route purchase orders and set up vendor payments. To complete the vendor master we need the following items (fastest path to PO creation):

- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached). Please fill legal entity exactly as on W-9 / tax documents.
- A signed W-9 (or equivalent tax form) for the legal entity.
- Bank letter or voided check for ACH setup (bank name, account last 4, routing).
- Primary accounts receivable contact (name, email, phone) and PO routing contact (name + email).
- Remit address and tax classification (LLC / Corp / Sole Prop).

I've attached a short checklist to help. If you can return items above by EOD Wednesday (12/2), we can get your first PO issued next week.

Marcus (cc'd) will validate tax and bank docs; Hannah will be the PO contact on our side while we finalize mapping in the ERP. If any of the documents are sensitive, you can upload to the DocuSign/secure link I'll send upon request.

Attachments: stolton_vendor_onboarding_form.docx, vendor_master_checklist.pdf

Thanks — speak soon,

Laura — thanks for the ping and thanks Aisha for the docs. Quick validation notes after a brief review:

- W-9: Name matches 'Stolton Industries, Inc.' and EIN present — good.
- Bank letter: contains full account#; for security we'll request a redacted bank letter plus an ACH verification form from the bank or a voided check.
- Remit address OK. We need a copy of any VAT/GST registration if Stolton has an EU entity in the future, but not required for US payments.

Hannah — please take PO routing ownership and map procure.ops@stolton.com as the default PO recipient. I'll drop the tax validation note into the vendor record once we get the redacted bank doc.

Aisha — re: MSA: our standard practice is to issue a one-off PO for an initial purchase while MSA is routed for signature in parallel unless your legal team requires MSA prior to any PO. If Stolton prefers MSA first, we can escalate to legal. Let me know preference.

--
